barriers.reason: The Thursday 11:30 AM session runs until about 3:30 PM, when the grandbabies get out of school at 3; the neighbor who helps on Tuesdays works Thursdays and the patient's daughter works until 6:30, so no one is available for the children during/after Thursday dialysis, which matches the missed and shortened Thursday sessions.

alternatives.text: Ask the dialysis unit for an earlier Thursday chair time so the 4-hour session ends before school pickup at 3, or request moving Thursday to a day when the patient has childcare coverage (e.g., keep Saturday).
Message the dialysis unit social worker to assess after-school/childcare support options and any benefits that could help cover Thursday care.
Discuss a peritoneal or home hemodialysis evaluation as a longer-term option to remove the fixed in-center Thursday schedule, noting it requires space, supplies, training, and home support.
